findings.rationale: The replacement states the intended suspicion naturally and avoids an unintended callback to the feces joke.
findings.replacement: “The target. Something about this guy is suspicious as hell.”

summary: The packet is coherent overall, but the active state preserves one already-resolved question while dropping the new hook about Taekyung’s mother. There are also repeated System-panel formatting inconsistencies, two awkward uses of “reeks to high heaven,” and minor wording drift around real-estate transactions.
